outcome: total number of embryos per gravid uterus
number of resorbing embryos per uterus
cohort: Laboratory mice, including one inbred (C57BL/6J) and two transgenic strains, from an animal research facility.
finding: Naturally-acquired Helicobacter infection significantly reduced the total number of embryos, increased resorbing embryos, decreased pregnancy-associated weight gain, and increased intrauterine hemorrhaging in laboratory mice, negatively impacting embryo health and reproductive success.
mod_finding: The study suggests that Helicobacter-free colonies can be rederived through Cesarean section and fostering with uninfected dams.
